shared_execution_rule: Every executable action passes the same Gate C legality, scenario safety policy and Gate B executor; safety rejects without repairing or substituting.

baselines.name: STATIC_HOLD
baselines.action_behavior: Return HOLD at every common decision epoch.

baselines.name: IGNORE_SETUP_DYNAMIC
baselines.action_behavior: Choose HOLD or a Gate-C-legal terminal-level target by evaluating instantaneous target-topology value with setup assumed zero; execute the chosen legal action with real Gate B/C setup.

baselines.name: HYSTERESIS_MINIMUM_HOLD
baselines.action_behavior: Apply a human-frozen minimum-hold duration and/or improvement threshold to the B1 or registered simple benefit signal.

baselines.name: SETUP_AWARE_GREEDY
baselines.action_behavior: Make a one-step HOLD/SWITCH decision from current topology benefit, real setup, usable lifetime and current queue/load without multi-step rollout.

baselines.name: PROPOSED_ROLLOUT_MPC_PLACEHOLDER
baselines.action_behavior: Generate terminal-pair proposals, filter conflicts/resources, run the real Gate B/C plus G_admit, common router, service and Q/I/D over a shared forecast horizon, then compare HOLD with candidate SWITCH actions by forecast-horizon network-wide J.

baselines.name: SMALL_EXACT_ORACLE
baselines.action_behavior: Exhaustively enumerate legal terminal-level actions and evaluate them over the registered short horizon on tiny fixtures only.
baselines.purpose: Validate greedy or rollout approximation quality.

rl_reconsideration_conditions: rollout computational cost is demonstrably excessive
registered short horizons demonstrably miss essential long-horizon dependence
non-learning controllers show a documented structural limitation
